import subprocess,json,sys
SC=["normal","mixed","partial-zero","empty","unknown","fail-fast","cancelled","live",None]
def run(path):
    out={}
    for s in SC:
        p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,path]+([s] if s else []),input=b"\n",capture_output=True,timeout=10)
        out[s]=(p.stdout,[json.loads(l) for l in p.stderr.decode().splitlines()],p.returncode)
    return out
